title: Binance Will List WOO Network (WOO)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list  WOO Network (WOO)  and will open trading for  WOO/BNB ,  WOO/BTC ,  WOO/BUSD  and  WOO/USDT  trading pairs at 2022-02-08 06:30 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  WOO  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for WOO will open at 2022-02-09 06:30 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page Only deposits of BEP-20 and ERC-20 WOO tokens will be credited to your Binance account What is WOO Network (WOO)? WOO Network is a liquidity network connecting traders, exchanges, institutions, and DeFi platforms through their suite of products including WOO X, Wootrade and WOOFi. WOO is the native token of the platform and users can use the token as collateral, to provide liquidity, and participate in staking. WOO Listing Fee: 0 BNB. Details: WOO Website WOO BEP-20 Block Explorer WOO ERC-20 Block Explorer Fees Rules Please note that Binance Labs has an investment interest in WOO Network. Please click  here  for more information. Risk warning : Cryptocurrency trading is subject to high market risk. Please make your trades cautiously. You are advised that Binance is not responsible for your trading losses.
